items.item_text: Be board certified or board eligible in Family Medicine
Ability to obtain a Medical License in the State of California
M.D. or D.O. degree and Prior Experience
The UCLA Department of Family Medicine seeks full-time Board Certified Family Physicians. As a Family Medicine

physician in the UCLA Department of Family Medicine, you will serve patients of all ages, provide comprehensive care for a wide range of conditions in the UCLA Health Clinic - West Adams neighborhood area.

Focus your team-based practice on the “whole patient” and provide on-going care over long periods of time forming lasting continuity and relationships. You will perform annual physicals, administer immunizations, routine screenings and focus on administering care over a long period of time often from infancy to adulthood. You will provide preventive care, wellness plans and manage chronic and complex conditions. Perform early screenings for signs of potentially serious conditions, such as cancer or heart disease. You will provide annual wellness screenings for senior patients.

Utilize your full breadth of family medicine clinical skills to treat a diverse patient population with diverse insurance. Experience caring for individuals from medically underserved backgrounds and providing care to a highly diverse population of patients is desired. We invite applicants with a commitment to community medicine. OB experience or OB-trained family physicians, or interest in full spectrum family medicine is highly valued.
We are seeking a staff family physician to join our dynamic, nationally-recognized department of family medicine. At UCLA Health, U can:
Be part of our dynamic academic Department of Family Medicine that also houses a family medicine residency program, and sports medicine and addiction medicine fellowship programs.
Join an academic department committed to community medicine that houses a community medicine fellowship.
Be a part of a team-based patient centered medical home with pharmacist support, co-located behavioral health, and patient navigation assistance.

Collaborate with some of the world’s top physicians, family medicine academic educators, and Department of Family Medicine researchers at the David Geffen School of Medicine. The department is in the top 10 department of family medicine in NIH research funding, and top 10 departments of family medicine in U.S. News & World Report Rankings (2023).
Work within a highly innovative academic practice environment, including Epic Systems.
Deliver leading-edge comprehensive and coordinated patient care
Be valued for your unique primary care medicine background and breadth and depth of clinical abilities

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
